featured_reviews.name: Tejas Sinagare
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are a Royal Enfield purist looking for a service center that respects the machine as much as you do, this is the place.
​What sets this team apart is their absolute refusal to resort to "jugaad." In an environment where quick fixes and makeshift repairs are the norms, these guys are a breath of fresh air. They rely strictly on genuine parts and a deep, technical understanding of the RE engine—whether it's a UCE, a 650 Twin,classic 500 or the newer J-series.
​Why I recommend them:
​Zero Shortcuts: They don't believe in "patching things up." If a part needs replacement, they use original spares, ensuring the longevity of the bike.
​Problem-Solving Mastery: Their diagnostic ability is top-tier. They don't just change oil; they listen to the taps, feel the vibrations, and resolve underlying issues that authorized centers often overlook.
​Machine Knowledge: It’s clear they understand the "soul" of these motorcycles. The bike feels tighter, smoother, and more responsive after a visit.
​It is rare to find a workshop that prioritizes engineering integrity over "Indian-style" temporary fixes. If you want your Enfield to run exactly how it was designed to, trust these experts. They truly know the machine best.
Thankyou so much Johnny sir for the best service of my bike my 14 years old machine feels like brand new...

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a bicycle from Arvind Cycle Company in Kalbadevi, and overall it was a satisfactory experience. The staff was helpful in explaining the available models and suggesting options within my budget. They have a decent range of basic and mid-range cycles, especially for daily commuting and general use.

The delivery was quick, and the cycle was assembled on the spot. However, I did notice that minor adjustments in gear shifting and brakes were required after a few days, which is quite common but worth mentioning.

Pricing is reasonable compared to other local shops, and being an authorised dealer gives some confidence regarding product authenticity.

Overall, a good place if you’re looking for an affordable, no-frills bicycle, but for premium or performance bikes, you may need to explore other stores.

I tried my best to inform him that he is wrong in for his own benefit, showed him online review videos but still he won't give up and then very rudely told me u give me the cycle back and take your money. I told him that he can give me a fresh piece and that this piece is faulty but he wouldn't budge. He knew he had given me a faulty piece and when I found it out he took the cycle back lest I make a scene.
Very very bad experience overall. Felt like I was robbed in broad day light
I finally bought the cycle in perfect condition with all the features at a much lower price.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Chakraverty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid This Service Center for Servicing your bikes!!

I took my Husqvarna Svartpilen 250 for servicing at this center and was charged ₹3,500. I had clearly mentioned two key issues:
1.	The radiator fan was constantly turning on and off, and
2.	The chain was too loose.

What I received in return was a highly disappointing and frustrating experience:

•	After the first service, new issues started, including strange noises from the bike. They took an entire day trying to fix it, failed, and then told me to “ride the bike and the issue will go away on its own” — which, of course, did not happen.
•	I gave them a second chance, took the bike back, again explained the noise and the heating issues. This time, the mechanic broke the sprocket lock and told me they didn’t have a replacement, and for the cooling issue, they did absolutely nothing.
•	Later, when I took it to an authorised Husqvarna service center, I was informed that the coolant pump was damaged, and the oil filter was blocked with some silicone-like material.
•	They cleaned the radiator and changed the coolant, but botched up the wiring, making the radiator fan rotate in the wrong direction (anticlockwise) — causing it to throw hot air out instead of sucking air in.
•	They used Castrol Radicool (gold bottle) coolant which needs to be diluted, but did not dilute it, affecting cooling efficiency. (The ready-to-use version comes in a white bottle, which they did not use.)

Despite all this, I remained patient and cooperative.

All in all instead of resolving problems, they created new ones using my money. Strongly advise against servicing your bike here.
